newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police arrest suspected ETA-linked youths.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police arrest suspected ETA-linked youths.

text.p: Spanish police said on Tuesday they had arrested 16 people allegedly affiliated to youth groups with links to the Basque separatist group ETA.
Police said the youths were suspected of being involved in violent street incidents in northern Spain. Twelve were arrested in Pamplona and four in Bilbao.
Street violence has risen in northern Spain over the past six months with gangs of hooded youths using firebombs to destroy public property.
In recent days, groups of hooded youths have torched a bus and fire-bombed train carriages and public buildings in northern Spain, although no one has been injured, police said.
Police have arrested 37 youths since the beginning of the year in the Navarre region alone.
ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) is fighting for an independent Basque state.
